findings.claim: The canonical example for the one-error-funnel-per-layer guide still shows the old pattern `catch (error) { throw this.httpErrorFactory.from(error); }` for SafeBalancesApi's getBalances/getCollectibles, but the diff changed these to use `from(mapBannedSafeError(error))`, so the documentation is now stale relative to src/modules/balances/datasources/safe-balances-api.service.ts:109 and :181.

The test hard-codes the upstream payload text `{ detail: 'Safe is unavailable for legal reasons' }` even though no assertion depends on that exact string since the mapper discards it, and a sibling test case instead uses faker.word.words(); this same hard-coded text also appears at line 69 and in both new integration specs.
